old_problem: The historical review correctly identified the danger of falsifying log metadata but treated log type, payload and recovery as unknown command semantics. IPMI 2.0 sections 31.12-31.13 define the legal types, exact MCA/OEM write vectors, readback and Get/Set optionality. A truthful owner-provisioned alternate log state, OEM schema, consumer containment and baseline reconciliation are strict runtime prerequisites rather than reasons to leave the standard OOB setter Pending.
disposition_reason: For one supported type at a time, preserve the 5Ah baseline and underlying log, require a real owner-approved alternate auxiliary-log state, build the exact nine-byte MCA or sixteen-byte OEM Set vector, obtain immediate confirmation, send 5Bh once over secure OOB, and require exact 5Ah readback plus agreement with the real log and its consumers. Restore the captured baseline only if no intervening legitimate log update occurred; otherwise the owner computes the current truthful status. Unsupported Set is per-type N/A because Get may exist alone. Never guess IANA/status bytes, fabricate timestamp/count, clear logs, hide faults, batch types or retry.
decision_basis: Master XLSX rows 1202-1205, related IB setter row 1077, exact same-row DeepSeek, exact GPT second review, tests.json, tests_gpt_merged, manifest and historical V3.1 record were directly read. The code is unique. Formal queue sequence 82 was independently verified from queue, manifest and XLSX as row 1205 / variant 0b80bfd6fd426cca.

IPMI v2.0 Appendix G and section 31.13 assign Set Auxiliary Log Status to Storage NetFn 0Ah/Cmd 5Bh. Legal Log Type values are 00h MCA, 01h OEM1 and 02h OEM2 with high nibble zero; every other value is reserved.

MCA Set request data totals nine bytes: type, four-byte IPMI timestamp and 32-bit entry count, both multi-byte fields least-significant byte first. FFFFFFFFh is the defined unspecified-count sentinel, not a fabricated large count.

OEM1/OEM2 Set request data totals sixteen bytes: type, four-byte timestamp, three-byte IANA Enterprise Number least-significant byte first and eight owner-defined status bytes. The standard supplies framing only, so the exact registered owner and versioned schema are non-negotiable.

Section 31.1 states Set is optional and cannot be implemented without Get, but Get may exist without Set. A successful row-1203 5Ah query never proves 5Bh writability; unsupported Set is accounted per type from authoritative completion/platform evidence.

Auxiliary status describes a real MCA or OEM log used by remote management. An arbitrary echoed vector can conceal faults or invent health. TARGET must represent a genuine isolated owner-approved log state and be checked against the underlying producer and downstream alert/diagnostic consumers.

A meaningful Set test needs TARGET to differ from BASE in at least one authorized semantic field. A same-value echo is insufficient mutation coverage, while an artificial field change with no real log state is unsafe and invalid.

Restoring a stale BASE after a legitimate concurrent log entry would itself falsify metadata. The transaction therefore enforces a quiet writer window; if the real log changes, it stops and delegates reconciliation to the log owner instead of blindly writing BASE.
The OOB setter uses host-verified secret-safe LANPlus and retains its own evidence. IB row 1077 and OOB Get row 1203 are supporting/different identities and cannot be credited as this Set test.

Generic log clearing is rejected because it destroys the evidence required to prove TARGET and restore. No SEL clear/delete, auxiliary-log clear/disable, event injection, BMC reset or consumer suppression belongs to this case.

ED-02 preserves identity; ED-03 separates standard/OEM authority; ED-13/ED-15 require exact draft and oracle; ED-17 preserves logs; ED-19 separates IB/OOB; ED-28/ED-30 require approval/recovery; ED-33/ED-34 allow bounded Project data without changing Master; ED-38 reserves verdicts and prohibits automatic retry.

test_case.test_name: IPMI Set Auxiliary Log Status (OOB Storage 0Ah/5Bh) truthful metadata/readback/reconciliation
test_case.purpose: Change one supported OOB auxiliary-log status to a truthful owner-controlled MCA or OEM state, prove exact Get readback and downstream consistency, then reconcile to the current truthful baseline without erasing evidence, guessing OEM meaning or conflating Get/IB coverage.
required_package: Verified BMC/SUT/firmware and host-verified secret-safe LANPlus endpoint; per-type 5Ah support and separately authoritative 5Bh support/writability evidence
Complete raw/decoded 5Ah BASE vector, corresponding MCA/OEM auxiliary-log evidence, producer/writer ownership, incident/retention status and downstream consumer/alert inventory
For MCA: truthful alternate timestamp/count from an owner-provisioned isolated log state; for OEM: returned registered IANA, exact versioned eight-byte schema and truthful alternate status
Quiet-writer or coordinated producer window, containment proving no production diagnostics are hidden/fabricated, immediate human confirmation and owner recovery/escalation
Pinned OOB 5Ah/5Bh runner with exact length/endian/reserved validation, one-type state machine, field comparator, no-retry control and protected evidence store
test_case.test_command: AUTHORIZED AUXILIARY-STATUS WRITE; DO NOT EXECUTE DURING REVIEW. Verify BMC/SUT/firmware/session, preserve auxiliary/SEL/BMC/OS evidence and query 0Ah/5Ah for the selected legal TYPE. Require exact schema and separately proven 5Bh support. Capture BASE and bind it to the real underlying log and consumer state. Establish a quiet writer window and an owner-provisioned truthful TARGET different from BASE. MCA TARGET is [00 TS0 TS1 TS2 TS3 COUNT0 COUNT1 COUNT2 COUNT3]; OEM TARGET is [TYPE TS0 TS1 TS2 TS3 IANA0 IANA1 IANA2 STATUS0..STATUS7], with all specified fields little-endian and reserved bits zero. Validate TARGET against the actual log, display BASE/TARGET, reason, consumer effect and recovery, then obtain immediate confirmation. Send exactly once over secret-safe OOB: ipmitool raw 0x0a 0x5b [TARGET]. Require completion 00h; query 0Ah/5Ah TYPE once and require exact field equality plus independent underlying-log/consumer agreement. If the log remains unchanged and BASE is still truthful, send BASE exactly once, require 5Ah equality and baseline consumer consistency. If any legitimate writer changed the log, do not restore stale BASE; freeze and hand the current log/status reconciliation to its owner. Process no second type until the first is safely reconciled. Never clear logs, inject an event, guess OEM data, retry or substitute IB/Get-only evidence.
test_case.expected_result: For the one approved supported type, the correctly sized and endian-safe 5Bh request returns completion 00h; 5Ah returns exact TARGET, and TARGET truthfully matches the underlying MCA/OEM log and allowed consumer behavior. With no intervening legitimate update, one exact BASE write restores 5Ah and the real log/consumer relationship. If Set is unsupported, that type is evidence-backed N/A. Echo-only success inconsistent with the real log, stale restore, wrong IANA/schema, unexpected alert suppression or any evidence loss is FAIL/NOT READY without retry.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires exact OOB identity, per-type Set support, legal selector, exact 9-byte MCA or 16-byte OEM vector, authoritative truthful TARGET different from BASE, immediate confirmation, one 5Bh write, exact 5Ah readback, independent producer/consumer agreement and safe current-baseline reconciliation. FAIL covers reserved/malformed bytes, guessed IANA/OEM status, fabricated timestamp/count, same-value pseudo-test, completion/readback without real-log truth, competing-writer overwrite, hidden fault, cleared evidence, stale restore, IB/Get substitution or retry. NOT READY covers missing support, BASE, alternate truthful state, owner schema, quiet window, containment, confirmation or recovery. N/A requires authoritative per-type Set-unsupported evidence.
safety_gate: Treat 5Bh as health-metadata mutation. Use a dedicated/isolated log context and never change production/shared diagnostic status or a log under incident, retention or compliance hold.
Preserve every auxiliary, SEL, BMC and OS evidence source before the write. The source boilerplate's log clear and any clear/disable/delete/inject workaround are prohibited.
Validate exact type-specific request length, little-endian timestamp/count/IANA, reserved nibble and owner schema. Unknown OEM byte meaning makes that type NOT READY.
TARGET must be both semantically different from BASE and truthful for a real approved log state. A convenient fabricated value or same-value write cannot test this setter.
Coordinate all writers and compare the real log immediately before confirmation and after readback. Any intervening entry cancels the planned restore and requires owner reconciliation.
One TARGET write and, only when still truthful, one BASE restore. No automatic retry, next-type continuation, BMC reset or evidence suppression after completion/readback/consumer mismatch.
Use secure OOB only for this identity. Row 1077 IB Set and row 1203 OOB Get retain independent coverage and evidence.
expected_evidence: Exact Source Key/variant; BMC/SUT/firmware/OOB session; official 5Ah/5Bh authority; distinct IB Set and OOB Get identities
Per-type Get and Set support, complete BASE vector, raw/decoded underlying auxiliary log, producer/writer ownership, incident/retention check and consumer baseline
Authoritative MCA target timestamp/count or OEM IANA/schema/eight-byte TARGET, truth rationale, quiet-window proof and containment analysis
Immediate confirmation plus exact redacted 5Bh request/completion, subsequent 5Ah field comparison and independent real-log/consumer correlation
Current-log check before restore, exact BASE reconciliation when valid or owner handoff when stale, final log/consumer consistency and preserved SEL/BMC/OS evidence
PASS/FAIL/NOT READY/N/A, no-retry and uncovered-type statement, explicitly confirming this review agent performed no DUT write
test_case.recovery: Keep the full BASE vector, raw underlying log and owner state before writing. If TARGET completion, readback or consumer correlation fails, stop all further types and preserve evidence. Restore BASE once only when the underlying log has not changed and BASE remains truthful; verify 5Ah and producer/consumer consistency. If a real entry or private writer changed state, never overwrite it with stale BASE—quarantine the test transaction and let the auxiliary-log owner calculate the current truthful vector or recover through the vendor mechanism. Unknown state, failed reconciliation or consumer impact is FAIL and requires escalation; do not clear logs, reset BMC or automatically retry.

source_conflict.reason: IPMI 2.0 resolves the TBD selector, exact 5Bh MCA/OEM vectors, 5Ah readback and Get/Set support relationship. The Review layer replaces evidence-clearing boilerplate with a truthful one-type transaction while leaving OEM field meaning Project-owned.

blocked.reason: Core Set framing, supported selectors, readback and unsupported behavior are standardized. Actual log type/support, truthful target state, OEM schema, writer coordination and recovery are bounded execution prerequisites.

external_authorities.title: Intelligent Platform Management Interface Specification v2.0 rev. 1.1 E7
external_authorities.application: Section 31.1 and sections 31.12-31.13/Tables 31-12/31-13 plus Appendix G define optional Storage 0Ah/Cmd5Ah/5Bh, legal selectors, MCA timestamp/count and OEM timestamp/IANA/eight-status-byte vectors, unsupported completion and the requirement that Set implies Get but not conversely.

project_authority: Auxiliary-log, BMC and diagnostic-consumer owners prove per-type setter support, supply the truthful alternate log state or IANA-matched OEM schema, coordinate writers, approve one mutation and own current-state reconciliation. They cannot authorize fabricated health metadata, same-value pseudo-coverage, stale restore, hidden faults, log clearing, automatic retry or IB/Get-only substitution.
